mentions.description: An intelligent fault detection diagnostics system for industrial-scale heat pump systems, combining a machine learning model with a sensor suite and an "OS" for technicians and maintainers to optimize their post-installation workflow processes. The system targets the difficulty of pinpointing diagnostics in systems with 6-7 figure datapoints and hundreds of components, exploring reinforcement learning on manufacturer stress-test datasets, digital-twin simulation, and a highly specialized LLM that produces step-by-step fix guides from system data.
mentions.problem: Heat pumps are replacing boilers as electrical thermal supply systems in the EU due to legislative changes, but performing accurate fault diagnostics at industrial scale is hard: systems have massive datapoints and hundreds of components requiring justifiably accurate real-time inference, and candidate approaches (reinforcement learning lacking full-system site data, digital twins that fail to align simulations with reality, specialized LLMs) each face major obstacles.
mentions.audience: Technicians and maintainers of industrial-scale heat pump systems
mentions.source_excerpt: The project is this, an Intelligent fault detection diagnostics system tailored for industrial scale Heat Pump systems.
